user_request: Add an unlabeled all-OPD variant: T+ sees clean input; T- and student see the original attacked input; no benign SFT.
decision: Keep the existing full-vocabulary T+/T- corrective objective; all attacked source rows enter OPCD with attack_gate=1 and c=1. Do not select on semantic A/U labels or perform calibration. The existing token-level disagreement/deficit mask remains part of the objective.

closest_implementation.transferable_contract: Clean prompt plus the same full realized student response; no gold response in teacher prompt; attacked student input.
closest_implementation.differences: Official implementation uses a single clean teacher and sampled reverse-KL advantages with online sampling; this variant retains T- and the existing OPCD full-vocabulary geometry on fixed initial rollouts.

reused_local_authority.hyperparameter_origin: R-OPCD-V3/configs/stage3o_fixed_rollout_train_qwen3_8b.json: eta=.7, delta_max=2, hybrid=.5, rank=8, alpha=16, lr=1e-5
reused_local_authority.not_adopted: Separate teacher_top32 ablation, clean SFT, label filtering, c calibration, old Qwen3-8B model/3072-token/non-thinking limits
reused_local_authority.model_adaptation: Qwen3_5 conditional generation text decoder; LoRA on full-attention q/k/v/o only. Linear-attention and vision weights stay frozen.

evaluation_contract.data: Existing frozen 9600 training candidates and exact initial-student rollouts; dev/test and parent utility controls are not training inputs.
evaluation_contract.evaluation: Not run in this packaging task. Any later AgentDojo evaluation must retain its procedural utility/attack-success scoring contract and matched inputs.
evaluation_contract.allowed_validation: CPU numerical gradients, tiny actual hybrid-model LoRA train/save/resume, all-row prompt and provenance validation, B200 runtime preflight and first-update gate on target.
evaluation_contract.stop_line: Refuse malformed or mismatched trajectories, hidden truncation, busy/wrong GPU, nonfinite or missing adapter gradients, uncommitted resume state, or changed provenance; preserve previous checkpoints.

runtime_decisions.layout: Reuse output/main generation; independent output/clean_opcd training with logs, caches, checkpoints, progress and receipts.
runtime_decisions.memory: One frozen BF16 base; teachers sequential with adapter disabled; checkpointed student decoder; chunked full-vocabulary head gradients with one decoder backward.
runtime_decisions.schedule: One seeded shuffled epoch, one trajectory per optimizer step, 9600 total. First successful update is checkpointed and counted, then continue; save every 100 and on graceful pause; keep last two committed checkpoints.
runtime_decisions.limitations: No B200 is accessible locally. CPU gates do not prove 27B GPU throughput, memory peak, or training effectiveness.
